 Diversified is a global leader in audio visual and media innovation, recognized for designing and building the world’s most experiential environments. Our award\-winning team specializes in delivering solutions for the most complex, large\-scale and immersive installations. Serving a global clientele that includes major media organizations and retailers, sports and live performance venues, corporate enterprises, and government agencies, Diversified partners with clients to create spaces that bring people together and keep them coming back.
   

  

**What To Expect**
 At Diversified, we're on a mission to create a world without boundaries, where technology enables all people to connect and experience the moments that matter, wherever they choose to be. With clients spanning the globe and an exciting pipeline of projects across industries, Diversified offers more than just a job. We offer a career path with the flexibility to grow personally and professionally, wherever your ambitions take you.
   

  

 As a Diversified associate, you'll dive headfirst into big, complex, and rewarding projects that push the boundaries of what's possible. Plus, you'll enjoy a flexible work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and a culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion.
   

  

**IF YOU CAN DREAM IT, YOU CAN DO IT AT DIVERSIFIED.**
**Job Summary**
 The Service Desk Agent Tier 2 is the second level of support and is responsible for in depth review of client reported and/or proactively found issues as a technical subject matter expert. The NOC Agent – Tier 2 will respond to client concerns and issues via phone and email, while working to make sure that the issues are resolved within Client Service Level Agreements. They will perform system diagnostics, problem identification and incident resolution in a proactive \& reactive call center environment.
   

  

**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
* Receive and track technical escalations from Tier 1 agents and determine required next steps for resolution.
* Provide second Tier of support for Clients, Technicians and subcontractors to identify, diagnose, and resolve incidents.
* Provide technical subject matter expertise for high profile clients that require a full understanding of their site(s)
* Provide content submissions for service Knowledge Base based on known issues, troubleshooting tips, etc.
* Complete technician site visit checkout activities via phone
* Provide detailed wrap up report to clients after remote session or technician onsite visit.
* Provide overflow support for Tier 1 agents.
* Ability to be on call periodically for overnight/weekend coverage.
* Proactive monitoring of client Networks across multiple platforms.
* Follow change management process to ensure the Asset Management database is up to date.
* Review programming support requests to verify scope and validity prior to submitting to Tech Ops for support.
* Recommend parts for replacement and scope of work statements for field service technicians.
* Perform thorough root cause analysis where required
* Perform and log system checks for specified client networks on a recurring basis.
* Adhere to all departmental and company\-wide guidelines, practices, policies and procedures.
* Log and track issues using incident/problem management database (ConnectWise) with accurate, up to date information.
* Work with NOC Tier 1 Agents, Service Coordinators, Field Technicians, subcontractors and clients to maintain communication on open service tickets.
* Maintain tickets; update and follow\-up with internal and external clients/personnel within the required contractual SLA timeframe.
* Review open tickets to ensure timely resolution.
* Provide updates to clients on any changes to their service ticket.
* Communicate with prospective clients and refer them to Sales as needed.
* Determine when an issue requires escalation to a higher\-level support member or management.


**Complexity**
 Handle multiple issues and prioritize which issue resolution demands priority while balancing quality and service delivery to clients.
   

  

**Decision Making Authority**
 Accountable for identifying issues that need to be escalated to Engineering, Management, or another internal party who can resolve.
   

  

**Physical Working Environment**
 Normal office conditions apply. Use of computer, monitors and communication tools. Sitting for long periods of time.
   

  

**Education/Certifications**
**Job Qualifications:**
* High School Diploma or GED
* Associates or Bachelor’s Degree (preferred)
* Certifications pertinent to technology area(s) of expertise (preferred), such as\-
* IT/Networking\- Cisco CCNA/CCNP Route Switch/Security; CompTIA Network\+;


 Microsoft SCCM; Azure
   

  

* AV/Control Systems\- Crestron DMC\-E\-4K, DMC\-T\-4K, DM\-NVX; AMX Programmer/101; Biamp Tesira Forte; QSC Q\-Sys Level 1, Level 2 ; Dante Level 1, 2, 3; Extron Control Specialist, AV Associate; Shure MXA
* Collaboration – Zoom; WebEx; CCNA/CCNP Collaboration
* Signage/Video Walls \- Barco Transform N; OpSpace
* Avixa CTS\-D / CTS\-I Certification (preferred)


**Required Knowledge, Experience And Skills**
* 3\+ years working in the AV/IT industry
* Experience with Control Systems, Audio, Video, Digital Signage, IT and/or Teleconferencing technologies (ie Cisco, BiAmp, Crestron, Samsung, QSC)
* 5\+ years working a customer service\-based role.
* Advanced level troubleshooting skills specific to technology area(s) of expertise


 such as\-
   

  

* Audio / DSP
* Projection, Display, and digital signage systems
* Unified Communications
* Network Monitoring software (Auvik/Automate/Meraki/RMS/ECM)
* Understanding of Network protocols and best practices.
* Process oriented.
* Ability to explain troubleshooting steps to non\-technical customers.
* Ability to solve problems and deal with variables in situations where limited standardization exists.
* Ability to provide an excellent customer experience to clients.
* Open to feedback and direction
* Accountable, reliable and takes ownership.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite.
* Exceptional interpersonal \& communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to quickly switch between tasks and work under pressure with excellent results.
* Ability to work both independently and within a team.
* Excellent organizational skills \& ability to maintain accurate records
* Ability to work in stressful situations.
* Ability to meet deadlines.


**Desired Knowledge, Experience And Skills**
* Experience with ticketing systems (ConnectWise, Salesforce, Service Now, Remedy, Zendesk, etc)
* Experience with ERP and/or CRM applications.


 To learn more about becoming part of the Diversified team, visit us at https://onediversified.com/careers/careers\-at\-diversified or email us at careers@onediversified.com.
   

  

 Diversified is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. All aspects of employment will be based on job requirements, individual qualifications, merit, performance, and business need.
   

  

 We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
   

  

 We believe in fair and equitable hiring practices and strive to create an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered.

title: Windows Server Operations Engineer
description:
Work Your Magic with us!
   

  

 Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Responsible for supporting Windows Server, Citrix, VMware, and related infrastructure services globally. Provide Level 2 technical support for incidents, service requests, problems, and changes, ensuring timely resolution within agreed SLAs.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting for Windows Server operating systems, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS, File Services, and Citrix environments. Support VMware virtual infrastructure including VM provisioning, resource optimization, snapshots, storage management, and lifecycle activities.
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call support, major incident management, emergency response activities, and scheduled maintenance windows. Demonstrate strong knowledge of PowerShell scripting and automation. Develop and maintain scripts to automate repetitive operational and administrative tasks.
* Experience processing API\-based web requests using PowerShell and integrating automation with cloud services. Drive operational efficiency through automation, self\-service solutions, and process standardization. Recommend innovative approaches to reduce manual effort and improve service reliability.
* Execute server, application, and infrastructure migrations using standardized and automated methodologies. Assess technical dependencies, risks, prerequisites, and business impacts before migration activities. Support cloud adoption, server modernization, and infrastructure transformation initiatives. Deliver approved IT improvements and business\-driven demand requests within agreed timelines. Lead technical investigations for complex incidents and service disruptions.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues. Own and drive Problem Management activities to reduce repeat incidents and improve service stability. Implement and execute infrastructure changes following the Global Change Management Process. Ensure qualification, testing, validation, implementation, and post\-implementation review activities are completed as required.
* Monitor system health, performance, capacity, and availability using enterprise monitoring tools. Proactively identify risks, vulnerabilities, capacity issues, and performance bottlenecks. Support backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity processes. Ensure operating systems, applications, and infrastructure components are patched and maintained according to company policies.
* Support security remediation activities, vulnerability management, and compliance initiatives. Participate in audit readiness activities and provide evidence for internal and external audits. Ensure adherence to corporate security standards, regulatory requirements, and operational policies. Support privileged access management, server hardening, and security baseline compliance. Maintain accurate configuration item (CI) records in CMDB and ensure infrastructure documentation remains current.

Coordinate and execute maintenance activities to ensure supported systems remain compliant with global standards. Create, maintain, and improve technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), knowledge articles, and operational runbooks. Ensure process documentation and Wikis are regularly reviewed and updated. Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous learning within the team.

* Track operational KPIs, incident trends, recurring issues, and improvement actions.
* Drive service reviews, governance meetings, and continual service improvement initiatives.


**What we offer:** 
 We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

title: Sr Technical Consultant - Python, Java Script, L2/L3 Support
description:
**Scope**
* We are looking for an experienced L3 Application Support Engineer with strong full stack technical knowledge and hands\-on experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and supporting enterprise applications.
* This is not a pure development role. The candidate will primarily work on application support, production issue analysis, root cause identification, incident resolution, performance troubleshooting, and coordination with development, QA, DevOps, infrastructure, and business teams. The role requires strong understanding of application architecture, APIs, databases, logs, integrations, and code\-level debugging to resolve complex production issues.


 What you'll do
   

  

* Act as the L3 technical support point for complex application issues, production incidents, escalations, and recurring problems.
* Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve issues across frontend, server\-side components, APIs, integrations, databases, and application workflows.
* Perform deep\-dive debugging using application logs, database queries, API traces, monitoring tools, and code analysis.
* Identify root cause of incidents and implement or coordinate long\-term fixes to prevent recurrence.
* Work closely with development teams to analyse defects, review code\-level issues, validate fixes, and support production deployments.
* Support application releases, hotfixes, patches, configuration changes, and production validation activities.
* Investigate performance issues related to application response time, database queries, API latency, integration failures, and system errors.
* Collaborate with QA, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, security, and business teams for end\-to\-end issue resolution.
* Understand application functionality, business workflows, and technical dependencies to provide effective production support.
* Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, RCA documents, and knowledge base articles.
* Monitor production systems, alerts, job failures, logs, and application health dashboards.
* Support incident, problem, and change management processes as per ITIL practices.
* Provide technical guidance to L1 and L2 support teams for issue triage, troubleshooting, and escalation handling.
* Participate in support improvement initiatives, automation opportunities, and operational stability improvements.
* Support business\-critical issues during off\-hours, weekends, or planned deployment windows when required.


 What we are looking for
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\-10 years of experience in application support, production support, technical support, or software development support roles.

title: Critical Support Operations Associate, Weekend Coverage
description:
Who we are
   

  

 About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

 About the team The Critical Support team is Stripe's frontline response function for urgent, high\-stakes user issues. We operate at the intersection of hands\-on support execution, incident response, and cross\-functional coordination. Our mandate is to protect users in their most business\-critical moments—resolving executive\-triggered escalations, urgent and critical\-priority cases, and complex issues that require more than a standard resolution path. We work closely with Internal Risk Management, Product, Engineering, and Legal to drive fast, coordinated outcomes. This is a greenfield team: we are building the operational foundations, workflows, and standards that will define critical support at Stripe for years to come.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 As a Critical Support OA, you will be the first operational responder on Stripe's most urgent and time\-sensitive user issues. You will execute against escalation cases across a wide range of complex scenarios—from executive\-triggered requests and critical payment failures to urgent user escalations requiring immediate cross\-functional coordination. This is a builder role: in addition to resolving cases, you will actively help shape the processes, playbooks, and operational standards that make this team function. You will develop a strong foundation in executive communication, complex problem\-solving under pressure, and operational execution in an ambiguous, high\-stakes environment.
   

  

 Note: Operation Associates in this role will work either Saturday to Wednesday, or Wednesday to Sunday.
   

  

 Responsibilities \* Case Execution: Handle escalation cases (Executive Escalations, User Escalations, urgent@/critical@) with speed and sound judgment, ensuring users in business\-critical situations receive timely, high\-quality support.
   

  

* Provide consistent, reliable coverage for our business critical support flows (urgent@ and critical@).
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Engage proactively with Incident Management, Risk, Product, Engineering, and other internal partners to drive resolution for complex issues that span multiple teams.
* Stakeholder Communication: Communicate clearly and professionally with senior internal stakeholders and high\-profile external users, distilling complex situations into concise updates.
* Process Building: Contribute actively to defining and documenting operational workflows, escalation criteria, and resolution playbooks as the team establishes its foundations.
* Queue Operations: Support Escalations queue duties during non\-shift time, including triage and review of ongoing escalation cases.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify patterns in case volume and resolution paths, surfacing actionable insights to improve team workflows and reduce recurring friction.


 Minimum requirements \* Completed secondary education or equivalent.
   

  

* Minimum 2 years of professional experience within Payments, Fintech, or SaaS support environments.
* Ability to cover Weekends consistency e.g. Saturday \- Wednesday or Wednesday \- Sunday.
* High agency: you operate with independence, take ownership of outcomes, and don't wait to be told what to do next.
* Ability to stay composed and exercise sound judgment in high\-pressure, ambiguous situations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adjust tone and level of detail for different audiences, including senior leadership.
* Collaborative approach to problem\-solving—you know when to escalate, when to coordinate, and when to drive toward a decision.
* Genuine user empathy paired with a drive to fix root causes, not just close tickets.
* Background in payments, fintech, or SaaS support environments.
* Completed secondary education or equivalent.


 Preferred qualifications \* AI Fluency: You have experience working with agentic workflows, prompting and iteration. You understand how to assess output quality and apply critical thinking in AI usage.
   

  

* Experience handling executive\-level or executive\-triggered support cases.
* Familiarity with incident management, SFDC or case management systems.
* Demonstrated interest in building operational programs—process documentation, workflow design, or cross\-functional project work.


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

title: Analyst - API Business
description:

 In this role, you will work closely with senior team members, Product, Tech, and CX teams to onboard and support API users including retail algo traders and emerging HNI clients.

 **Bengaluru office**

 ﻿﻿

title: SENIOR, SYSTEMS AND INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER
description:
**About The Team**
 CCC team also known as Command and Control Center forms the nerve center of Walmart . The team works across multiple technology groups to ensure the stability and reliability of the company's critical e\-commerce infrastructure. The team functions by collaborating internally with TDO (Technical duty officers and SRE (Site reliability engineering) for faster detection and mitigation of incidents The team is aimed at proactively maintaining mission critical infrastructure, cloud platforms, micro services, tools and processes to ensure highest levels of availability and reliability across the Global technology platforms. CCC plays a important role in leading all major incident responses and orchestrating for faster mitigation.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 You're right for the job if you are comfortable leading our major incident response team as part of a technical team of engineer’s laser focused on restoring service across complex distributed systems. You'll excel if you have enthusiasm for digging deep, and a flare for sharp technical communication, prioritization and organization. You will work directly with our SRE, Engineering and DevOps teams to support our next generation “always up” cloud\-based e\-commerce platforms.
   

  

 The CCC Site Reliability Operations Engineer is responsible for pro\-actively monitoring, detecting and resolving site issues before they become customer and availability impacting. Technically you will understand the full end to end stack and use this knowledge to detect errors/failures and take corrective action to mitigate. During a major incident, you will draw on your technical skills and knowledge to triage and troubleshoot, differentiating between symptom and cause, to help restore impacting issues. title: Freight Forwarding Specialist (Customer Adoption)
description:
Sidecar is a 24/7 AI teammate for freight forwarders. It reads the inbox, quotes the lane, chases the shipment. This role is for someone who has worked at a freight forwarder. You will sit with our customers' pricing, operations and documentation teams, get them using Sidecar every day, and bring what you hear back to the people building it.
 



  





**About Sidecar** 




 Ever wonder how your phone got here from a factory in Shenzhen, or how a jacket from Italy reached your door in 5 days? Behind every shipment is a freight forwarder: the middleman coordinating ships, customs, warehouses, and trucks, still running on email, spreadsheets, and software from 1998\. Sidecar gives them an AI teammate that calls, emails, logs into systems, and executes complex tasks end to end. We are backed by leading Silicon Valley VCs, angel investors, and industry advisors. Built in HSR, Bangalore.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Our customers are freight forwarders. The people who use Sidecar quote rates, chase shipping lines, file documents and answer customer mails all day. New software lands on that desk on top of everything else, and it only sticks when someone who has done the job sits next to them and shows them how it fits.
 



 That is this role. You have worked on a forwarder's desk, in pricing, sea or air operations, customer service or documentation. You know what a rate request looks like at 6 pm on a Friday and which parts of the day nobody has time for. You use that to get branches live, keep them live, and tell us plainly what is getting in the way.
 



 You will spend a lot of your time at customer offices and branches, on calls with users, and in our dashboard looking at who is using what. You work with the product team, the founders, the engineers and our other domain specialists.
   





**Responsibilities** 



* Onboard branches and users.
 
 Set up new customers and branches, train pricing, operations and documentation teams on Sidecar, and sit with them through the first weeks until the new way of working is the default.
* Field visits.
 
 Travel to customer offices and branches, run training at their desks, watch how people actually work and find where Sidecar fits or gets in the way.
* Day\-to\-day support.
 
 Be the first person users call. Resolve what you can on the spot, and turn the rest into clear tickets for product and engineering, with the shipment, the mail and the expected outcome attached.
* Follow\-through.
 
 Track every open item across customers and internal teams until it is closed. Nothing waits on "I'll check and get back."
* Usage monitoring.
 
 Watch usage by customer, branch and user. When a desk goes quiet, find out why and fix it, whether that is training, a missing feature or a process problem on their side.
* Voice of the desk.
 
 Turn recurring problems into specific feedback for product, technology and operations, in the user's language and with examples.
* Account relationships.
 
 Keep branch heads, pricing managers and operations leads updated on where their rollout stands, and keep the relationship warm between visits.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Freight forwarding background.
 
 This is the requirement. 3 to 7 years at a freight forwarder, NVOCC, shipping line agency or customs broker, in pricing, sea or air export\-import operations, customer service, key accounts or documentation. You have handled rate requests, bookings, shipping instructions, bills of lading and customer follow\-ups yourself.
* Fluent in the desk.
 
 Incoterms, FCL and LCL, carrier and co\-loader coordination, shipping bills and port and customs portals are part of your working day, not things you have read about.
* People and phone.
 
 You can walk into a branch, get a busy pricing team to give you 30 minutes, and leave with them using the product. Frequent calls do not tire you.
* Travel.
 
 Regular visits to customer offices and branches across India.
* Follow\-up discipline.
 
 You keep a list, you close it, and people trust you to come back with an answer.
* Practical with data.
 
 Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets, reading usage reports and keeping a simple tracker.
* Curious about AI.
 
 You want to see what AI does to the desk you came from, and you pick up new software fast.
* Bengaluru, HSR Layout.
 
 Based at our office, on the road to customer branches when a rollout needs you there.



  





**Benefits** 



* Top\-bracket pay.
 
 We pay at the top of the market.
* Health insurance.
 
 Comprehensive cover.
* Gym and wellness.
 
 Wellness benefits, on us.
* Lunch and dinner.
 
 Provided at the office.
* Snacks and caffeine.
 
 Unlimited snacks, coffee, Red Bull, Diet Coke.

 of experience in

 , preferably in

 .
* Proven experience managing customer implementations from kickoff through activation.

* Strong operational thinking and a continuous improvement mindset.

 **ERP, accounting, or financial system** 
 integrations is a plus.

title: Systems Engineering Specialist - Endpoint Management
description:
**Req ID:** 
 378363
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering Specialist \- Endpoint Management to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
   

  

 We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid\-level role involves independently managing end\-to\-end endpoint lifecycle operations — OS deployment, patch management, application delivery, and device compliance — for large global enterprise clients. The engineer will handle complex L2/L3 incidents, contribute to platform improvements, and serve as a reliable technical contributor within NTT DATA's EPM managed services practice supporting clients across US, APAC, and EMEA geographies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 OS Deployment \& Image Management
   

  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe\-and\-reload, and in\-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune\-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.


 Patch Management
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end patch management operations for SCCM\-managed and Intune\-managed endpoints across client accounts.
* Configure and manage Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs) for monthly Microsoft Patch Tuesday cycles.
* Manage Windows Update for Business (WUfB) rings, feature update policies, and quality update deferrals in Intune.
* Perform patch impact analysis, rollback planning, and emergency patching for zero\-day vulnerabilities.
* Generate and present patch compliance dashboards and exception reports to delivery leads and client stakeholders.
* Coordinate with security teams to address Qualys/vulnerability scan findings within SLA timelines.


 Application \& Software Management
   

  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.


 Infrastructure \& Platform Management
   

  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.


**Required Skills**
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, patch management, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co\-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client\-facing delivery and documentation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD\-102\) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM\-to\-Intune co\-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM
* Experience in NTT DATA, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, or similar IT outsourcing delivery models


 MINIMUM EDUCATION
   

  

 Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent experience and industry certifications will be considered.
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R\&D.
   

  

 Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
   

  

**The Team:**
 Celonis Support Services team operates a 3\-Level Support model, which includes a dedicated highly\-trained team of Celonis experts located in our Celonis Support Centre. Our support engineers are familiar with the common challenges organisations face when deploying Celonis software and are able to quickly diagnose and support the questions regarding product\-related issues our customers face and provide technical support for Celonis On\-Premise and Cloud\-based products. * Drive and resolve complex Tickets according to ITSM processes

* Participate and drive regular Root Cause Analysis (RCA) cycles to improve our Support Knowledge base

* Participate in 24x7 Support model

* A fundamental working ability of heterogeneous Linux/Unix systems.
* Knowledge in one or more areas: SSO, JKS, Docker, Kubernetes, Datadog, Python, Java
* Have a structured approach to analyse and resolve issues
* Ideally, experience with database systems and SQL
* Experience with AWS and / or MS Azure.
* Customer contact experience, communication and service\-oriented.
* A thirst to learn and like bringing ideas to the table.

 Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI\-driven processes. title: IT Customer Service Representative Copy 01
description:
As an IT Customer Support Shift Lead, the candidate should be responsible for managing the delivery of IT Infrastructure services meeting all the SLA’s focusing on Customer Experience. This role requires a combination of technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and the ability to prioritize tasks effectively. Ensuring smooth operation of technology tools and addressing technical issues promptly and delivering high\-quality support to optimize productivity and efficiency.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Lead the delivery of IT Infrastructure services \& ensure all the SLA’s are met.
* Manage Incident, Issues and Outage management, Investigation, and restoration.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure timely resolution of issues.
* Ensure compliance with IT policies, procedures, and standards are followed.
* Provide technical assistance and support to the leadership team members for tablets, smartphones, network\-related and other peripheral devices.
* Diagnose and resolve technical problems promptly, ensuring minimal disruption to the workflow of the leadership team.
* Stay informed about emerging technologies and trends in IT support.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, systems, and tools to enhance the efficiency of IT support.
* Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for hardware/software procurement, maintenance, and support as needed.
* Conduct training sessions or provide individual guidance to team members on new technologies, software applications, and best practices for IT usage.
* Provide operational support role in a multi\-shift 24/7 and should be able to work across various shifts.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Windows \& Cloud Management.
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with Desktop Transformation, Microsoft 365, and Network Infrastructures.
* Strong understanding of IT Operations and Service Management.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes and methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of hardware, software, and networking concepts.
* Experience with incident, problem and change management processes.
* Knowledge of IT policies, procedures, and standards.
* Excellent communication and Collaboration skills.
* Proven experience in providing technical support in a corporate environment, preferably supporting executive\-level staff.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with IT security best practices and data privacy regulations.
* Certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), Cloud, or Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) are a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a customer\-centric approach to IT support.
* Proficiency in troubleshooting technical issues and providing timely solutions.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Candidate should have a minimum of 6\+ years of experience in Microsoft Windows/Cloud Management \& 2 years in Team Management.
* The ideal candidate will possess a strong educational background in computer science or a related field, along with a proven track record of delivering impactful IT solutions.
* Work from Office \& in multiple Shifts.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
**Job Title**
 Technical Consultant
   

  

**About Skyhigh Security**
 Skyhigh Security is a dynamic, fast\-paced, cloud company that is a leader in the security industry. Our mission is to protect the world’s data, and because of this, we live and breathe security. We value learning at our core, underpinned by openness and transparency.
   

  

 Since 2011, organizations have trusted us to provide them with a complete, market\-leading security platform built on a modern cloud stack. Our industry\-leading suite of products radically simplifies data security through easy\-to\-use, cloud\-based, Zero Trust solutions that are managed in a single dashboard, powered by hundreds of employees across the world. With offices in Santa Clara, Aylesbury, Paderborn, Bengaluru, Sydney, Tokyo and more, our employees are the heart and soul of our company.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security Is more than a company; here, when you invest your career with us, we commit to investing in you. We embrace a hybrid work model, creating the flexibility and freedom you need from your work environment to reach your potential. From our employee recognition program, to our ‘Blast Talks' learning series, and team celebrations (we love to have fun!), we strive to be an interactive and engaging place where you can be your authentic self.
   

  

 We are on these too! Follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter@SkyhighSecurity.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Consultant in the Skyhigh Customer Value team, you will play a critical role in ensuring customers maximize the value of our solutions. You will guide customers through their product adoption journey, ensuring seamless deployment, integration, and continuous optimization. This role will develop deep relationships with our largest customers and complete the technical onboarding process for our smaller customers. By leveraging your technical expertise and customer\-centric approach, you will drive operational success, best\-practice adoption, and long\-term customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Technical Consultants directly guide our customers throughout their product adoption journey, ensuring they achieve their security and network transformation goals.
   

  

**Deployment and Execution**
* Implement SWG, CASB, ZTNA, DLP, and other SSE security solutions based on the Solution Architect’s design.
* Configure security policies, user access controls, and enterprise integrations.
* Perform policy migration and optimization to ensure compliance and best practices.
* Conduct pilot testing, UAT, and final production rollout.
* Deliver technical training and enablement to customer teams to effectively manage the product.


**Customer Engagement \& Support**
* Provide ongoing technical guidance and troubleshooting support for complex issues.
* Lead best practice workshops and enablement sessions to upskill customer teams.
* Provide continuous education and coaching to customers on existing and new features to ensure they maximize the value of the solution.
* Provide context and help to the Support team to ensure that service requests are addressed and effectively communicated to the customer.
* Manage and escalate customer concerns internally when necessary.


**Customer Adoption \& Expansion**
* Act as the technical point of contact post\-deployment, ensuring customers fully adopt, optimize, and expand their SSE solution.
* Monitor solution performance, adoption and provide proactive recommendations to improve efficiency, security, and compliance.
* Participate in business reviews and conduct technical health checks to track progress and address gaps.
* Identify opportunities for expansion by assessing additional use cases, security.
* Assist with change management and internal advocacy within customer teams to drive long\-term adoption.
* Collaborate with Customer Success Manager, Sales, and Product teams to align solutions with customer objectives.


**Documentation, Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement**
* Document deployment procedures, configuration settings, and optimization strategies.
* Contribute to the internal knowledge base for Professional Services and TAM best practices.
* Mentor and coach other Technical Consultants and Technical Account Managers to enhance team expertise.
* Contribute to internal knowledge\-sharing initiatives, training programs, and best practice discussions.
* Provide feedback on customer pain points and feature requests to Product and Engineering teams.
* Stay up to date with industry security trends, emerging threats, and SSE product advancements.


**Background And Experience Required For a Technical Consultant**
* 7 to 10\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing technical role (Technical Consultant, Solution Architect, Technical Account Manager, Sales Engineer, or similar).
* Ready to work on permanent EST shift
* Strong background in network security, cloud security, and SSE/SASE solutions.
* Experience with firewalls, proxies, CASB, DLP, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and SWG (Secure Web Gateway).
* Proficiency in network protocols, authentication mechanisms, and security frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with a customer\-first mindset.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for various audiences.
* Experience coaching and training customers to use technical products effectively.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts while prioritizing key customer needs.
* It would be great if you also have the following, but they are not required:
* Industry certifications such as CCNA Security, Comptia security\+, AWS/Azure Security, CCSK/CCSP or CISSP.
* Experience working with large enterprise customers and managing multi\-region
* deployments.
* Experience working with PSA tools (Open Air, Financial Force etc.).
* Customer Value Career Path


**Career Progression In Customer Value**
 The natural progression for someone who has demonstrated full proficiency, and executed at a ratings level of ‘Above Target’ consistently would be to prepare a succession plan for a role as a Solution Architect, focused on the design of the integration of Skyhigh products in the customer environment to execute against their use cases and create value realization. Further growth opportunities may include moving into leadership roles such as Manager, Customer Value team based on expertise and career aspirations.
   

  

**Company Benefits And Perks**
 We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family\-friendly benefits to all of our employees.
   

  

* Retirement Plans
* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Support for Community Involvement


 We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry\-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.
   

  

**Our Commitment To You**
 At Skyhigh Security, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process.
   

  

 Skyhigh Security also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Skyhigh Security will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process.

title: Help Desk Analyst
description:
**About York Solutions** 




 With over 25 years of experience, we are a technology consulting firm that uses a non\-transactional, value\-based approach to provide clients with custom technology and workforce solutions to achieve business, technology, and operational goals. Using a strategic partnership approach with our clients, York Solutions focuses on fostering a long\-term, trust\-based relationship.
 



  





 At York Solutions, we believe technology is about empowering people. Our team is built on collaboration, accountability, integrity, continuous learning, and delivering exceptional service to both our consultants and clients. We are looking for a customer\-focused
 **Help Desk Analyst** 
 who enjoys solving problems, takes pride in delivering outstanding user experience, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment.
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Help Desk Analyst is responsible for preparing, deploying, shipping, receiving, and supporting laptop computers for consultants working with York Solutions' clients. This role combines technical support with logistics and customer service, ensuring every consultant receives a fully configured device and a smooth onboarding experience.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is organized, detail\-oriented, technically proficient, and enjoys helping others succeed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Device Imaging \& Configuration** 



* Image and configure Windows laptops using standard corporate deployment tools.
* Install approved software, security applications, and client\-specific configurations.
* Perform quality assurance testing to ensure devices are deployment\-ready.
* Maintain imaging documentation and deployment procedures.
* Troubleshoot imaging and hardware issues.



  





**End User Support** 



* Assist new hires with initial laptop setup.
* Guide users through logging into their laptops using credentials provided by the client's IT department.
* Troubleshoot login, MFA, VPN, and basic Windows issues.
* Escalate issues requiring client IT involvement while maintaining ownership of the user experience.
* Provide clear, professional communication throughout the onboarding process.



  





**Shipping \& Receiving** 



* Prepare laptops and accessories for shipment.
* Coordinate shipping with carriers to ensure timely delivery.
* Receive returned equipment and inspect for damage.
* Perform asset recovery, data sanitization (when applicable), and reimage returned devices.
* Track shipments and maintain accurate inventory records.



  





**Asset Management** 



* Maintain accurate inventory of laptops, accessories, and peripherals.
* Update asset management systems with device assignments and returns.
* Monitor inventory levels and notify management of replenishment needs.
* Ensure compliance with client and company asset management policies.



  





**Documentation** 



* Create and maintain support documentation.
* Record incidents, service requests, and resolutions.
* Contribute to knowledge base articles and process improvements.



  





**Requirements** 



* Associate degree in Information Technology or equivalent work experience.
* 3\-5 years of Help Desk, Desktop Support, or IT Support experience.
* Experience imaging Windows laptops.
* Knowledge of Windows 11 and Microsoft 365\.
* Familiarity with Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), or similar identity platforms.
* Basic networking knowledge.
* Experience using ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira, Zendesk, Freshservice, or similar).
* Strong troubleshooting and communication skills.
* Ability to safely lift, carry, and move laptop shipments and related equipment weighing up to 18 kg (40 lbs).



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience supporting enterprise laptop deployments.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, SCCM/MECM, or similar endpoint management tools.
* Experience with asset management systems.
* CompTIA A\+ or similar certification.
* Experience supporting remote users.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Exceptional customer service mindset.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Problem\-solving mentality.
* Dependable and accountable.
* Team\-oriented with a collaborative approach.
* Comfortable working independently while knowing when to escalate issues.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Laptops are deployed accurately and on schedule.
* New users experience smooth onboarding with minimal downtime.
* Asset records remain accurate and current.
* Support tickets are resolved efficiently and professionally.
* Positive feedback from consultants, clients, and internal teams.
* Continuous identification of opportunities to improve processes and documentation.



  





**Why Join York Solutions?** 




  





 At York Solutions, you'll be part of a team that values:
 



  




* **People First:** 
 We build lasting relationships through trust and respect.
* **Service Excellence:** 
 We strive to exceed expectations in every interaction.
* **Collaboration:** 
 We work together to solve problems and support one another.
* **Integrity:** 
 We do the right thing, even when no one is watching.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 We embrace learning, innovation, and process improvement.
* **Accountability:** 
 We take ownership of our work and deliver on our commitments.



  





 If you're passionate about technology, enjoy helping people, and want to make a meaningful impact in a collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





 To learn more about our company, visit:
 
 www.yorksolutions.net
 




  





**York Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** 
 We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and abilities and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process.

 Bangalore, India
 



**Experience:** 
 4\+ years
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Department:** 
 Engineering
 




  





**About Us** 





 Qure.ai
 
 is a global healthtech company using artificial intelligence to improve disease detection and patient outcomes at scale. Our solutions are deployed across hospitals, diagnostic networks, and public health programs worldwide.
 



 Today, our technology has impacted
 **40M\+ lives** 
 across
 **105\+ countries** 
 , deployed across
 **5,200\+ sites** 
 , and powered by one of the world’s largest real\-world medical imaging datasets. With
 **26 FDA\-cleared indications** 
 , we are helping shape the future of AI\-driven healthcare.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We have an exciting opportunity for an
 **IT Infra Engineer** 
 to join our IT team. The candidate will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day user support, resolving L1 technical issues, preparing and maintaining laptops/desktops, managing user accounts, groups and access through Active Directory, supporting basic network, VPN, Wi\-Fi and email\-related issues, maintaining IT assets, monitoring antivirus and endpoint health, and updating IT documentation, network diagrams and knowledge base articles. We are looking for someone with good troubleshooting skills, basic networking knowledge, hands\-on experience in desktop support, and strong communication skills.
 



  





**What You’ll Own \& Drive** 




 · Provide day\-to\-day IT support for internal users, including troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and access\-related issues.
 



 · Own ticket resolution from intake to closure, ensuring timely updates, proper documentation, and strong user communication.
 



 · Support laptop, desktop, printer, peripheral, and mobile device setup, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
 



 · Manage user onboarding and offboarding activities, including system provisioning, account setup, access control, and asset allocation.
 



 · Monitor and resolve issues related to Wi\-Fi, VPN, email, collaboration tools, operating systems, and business applications.
 



 · Maintain IT assets, inventory records, device health, and compliance with internal IT policies.
 



 · Escalate complex technical issues to senior IT, infrastructure, security, or vendor teams while tracking them through resolution.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 In the first 6–12 months, you will:
 



 · Build a strong understanding of the company’s IT environment, support processes, tools, security policies, and escalation workflows.
 



 · Independently handle common L1/L2 support requests across devices, applications, network connectivity, and user access.
 



 · Improve ticket response and resolution quality through consistent documentation, follow\-ups, and user\-focused communication.

title: IT Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
 Lumilens Inc. is seeking an experienced IT Specialist for our Bangalore office to deliver high\-quality end\-user support for Windows and macOS environments, while also contributing to basic network operations and Microsoft Azure / M365 administration. The ideal candidate balances strong hands\-on desktop support skills with foundational cloud and network competencies and communicates effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**End\-User Support**
* Provide L1/L2 desktop support for Windows 10/11 and macOS across the Singapore office
* Laptop provisioning, imaging, configuration \& lifecycle management (Windows \& Mac)
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, peripherals, printers \& AV equipment
* Manage software installations, patch management \& OS updates
* Support onboarding \& offboarding — device setup, account creation \& asset handover
* Maintain IT asset inventory and track hardware/software licenses


**Network \& Connectivity**
* Manage basic LAN/Wi\-Fi connectivity troubleshooting for end users
* Support VPN client configuration and remote access for Singapore staff
* Coordinate with regional Network Engineer for escalations and site\-level changes
* Assist in cable patching, switch port configuration \& Wi\-Fi AP management


**Cloud \& M365 Administration**
* Manage M365 user accounts, licenses \& groups via Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
* Support Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange Online for Singapore users
* Assist in Intune/Endpoint Manager device enrolment \& compliance policy enforcement
* Handle Azure AD user provisioning, password resets \& MFA troubleshooting


 Technical Requirements
   

  

**End\-User \& Desktop**
* Strong troubleshooting (Group Policy, registry, event logs)
* System Preferences, MDM enrolment, iCloud \& keychain management (macOS)
* Laptop repair, RAM/SSD replacement, peripheral setup
* Experience with ITSM/Ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Freshdesk, Jira Service Desk, or equivalent)
* Imaging \& deployment (SCCM, Intune, Autopilot, MDT)
* Antivirus/EDR (CrowdStrike, Defender for Endpoint, or equivalent)


**Networking (Foundational)**
* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs — conceptual \& operational understanding
* Basic Wi\-Fi troubleshooting (Aruba, Cisco, Meraki, or similar cloud\-managed APs)
* VPN clients (Cisco AnyConnect, Global Protect, or equivalent)
* Basic switch/router CLI (Cisco/HP/Aruba) for port checks \& VLAN tagging


**Microsoft Azure \& M365**
* User \& group management, SSO, Conditional Access, MFA (Microsoft Entra ID)
* Device enrolment, compliance policies, app deployment (Microsoft Intune)
* M365 Apps administration (Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, OneDrive)
* Azure portal navigation, resource groups, VM/storage awareness
* Basic scripting for M365 user management \& automation (PowerShell)


**Qualifications**
* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in IT, Computer Science, or related field
* 5–8 years of hands\-on IT support \& systems administration experience
* Proven experience supporting both Windows and macOS in a corporate environment
* Microsoft certifications: MS\-900, MD\-102, AZ\-900, or equivalent (preferred)
* Strong English communication — verbal, written, and documentation skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in the Bangalore office


 Good to Have
   

  

* Experience in a manufacturing or technology company (multi\-site environment)
* Familiarity with Lumilens tools: ERP, Slack/Teams, SharePoint
* Exposure to CCTV/physical security or AV systems management
* Basic understanding of SASE/Zero Trust concepts (SDWAN or similar)
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent service management exposure
* Mandarin or Malay language skills a plus for local stakeholder support


 Lumilens is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, identity, orientation, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

description:
RSA provides trusted identity and access management for 12,000 organizations around the world, managing 25 million enterprise identities and providing secure, convenient access to millions of users. RSA specializes in empowering security\-first organizations in financial services, healthcare, energy, technology services, and other industries to thrive in a digital world, delivering complete capabilities for modern authentication, access, lifecycle management, and identity governance.  MCAPS\-Core accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact.  In the Customer Service \& Support (CSS) team we are looking for people with a passion for delivering customer success. As a Technical Support Engineer, you will own, troubleshoot, and solve customers’ technical issues.  Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* Readiness: You lead or participate in building communities with peer delivery roles and, where appropriate, share your knowledge.
* You develop specific technical and professional proficiency to enable you to resolve customer issues, through training and readiness.
* Product/Process Improvement: You identify potential product defects and escalate appropriately to resolve, contributing to Microsoft product improvements.

 Strong Troubleshooting and problem solving skills
   

  

 Excellent customer Service skills and effective learning skills

 Strong Experience in Active Directory Services.
   

  

 Strong Experience in ADS, Group Policies, FSMO Roles, DNS Zones, Replications etc
   

  

 Trouble shooting and problem solving skills

 OR 3\+ years of technical support, technical consulting experience, or information technology experience
   

  

 OR equivalent experience
   

  

 Language Qualification
   

  

 English Language: fluent in reading, writing and speaking.

title: Rail Solution Operations Engineer
description:
Req ID:525935
   

  

 Alstom's modern railway fleets are no longer just mechanical systems — they are connected digital platforms. The trains and ground systems continuously communicate in both directions to enable capabilities far beyond simple monitoring. Ground systems can send speed advice to the driver to save energy, wake up trains, check their fitness, push operational configurations, and control on\-board systems such as HVAC and lighting remotely. In the most advanced deployments, operators can remotely drive the train to the first station. Because these functions are managed at fleet level, the availability of these ground systems is critical to our customers' daily operations. As a customer\-centric services company, Alstom is committed to offering a fully managed service with target SLAs on availability, response, and resolution times.
   

  

 As a strategic initiative, we are building a central L2 support team in Bangalore that will support wayside systems across all global customer projects. The main goal of the team is to diagnose and restore service using runbooks as quickly as possible. For complex issues, the team escalates to the project engineering and solution development teams. The support team monitors application health 24x7 using Dynatrace — detecting and responding to anomalies before they impact the customer.
   

  

 The team is based in Bangalore and operates during standard office hours. To support global customer projects across multiple time zones, a 24x7 on\-call rotation is in place for critical incidents outside office hours.
   

  

 As a mid\-level engineer, you will work independently on assigned applications and incidents, contributing actively to the team's operational quality under the guidance of the Senior Rail Solution Operations Engineer.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Support L2 operational monitoring and incident management for assigned wayside digital railway solutions delivered to our customers
* Investigate and resolve incidents end\-to\-end using approved runbooks — escalating to the senior engineer or L3 teams with full documentation when resolution is beyond runbook scope
* Monitor application health using Dynatrace — review dashboards daily, respond to alerts, and report anomalies proactively
* Participate in OS patching activities — coordinate scheduling, raise change requests in ServiceNow, and validate application health pre and post patching
* Maintain and update runbooks after every incident where gaps or inaccuracies were identified
* Support new project onboarding — participate in knowledge transfer sessions and shadow operations under guidance of the senior engineer
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotation for critical incidents


**Our Expectations**
**Must Have**
* Railway domain knowledge with 8\+ years of experience across railway systems — e.g. Signalling, TCMS, PIS, CCTV
* Hands\-on experience with IT technologies — Linux, TCP/IP, Docker, Database
* Ability to follow and apply systems engineering thinking
* Experience managing incidents in live operational environments — logging, triaging, resolving, and escalating


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with container and cloud technologies — Kubernetes, Azure or AWS
* Python or Bash scripting for operational tasks
* Familiarity with observability tools — Dynatrace, Grafana or equivalent


 We are building this team from the ground up. You will help build it, shape it, and grow with it. And every time you board a train — anywhere in the world — you will know that people like you are the reason it runs on time. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk.
   

  

**Important to note**
 As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.
